title: DocumentReleaseSourceDisposition
description: The disposition projection for one member of the requested universe U. Every member of U gets a row, so a consumer obtains corpus membership and exclusion coverage from this release alone, without reading the source catalog.

sourceIssuedVersion.description: The version the SOURCE issued, projected unchanged from the catalog. Never a capture digest.

catalogDisposition.description: Projected verbatim from the pinned SourceCatalogRelease. This release never re-decides a selection; a capture result feeds no fact back into the catalog.

documentVersionId.description: The document/version this item became. Non-null exactly when catalogDisposition is `selected`.

processingFailures.description: Failures encountered while processing this item. Recorded, never load-bearing for membership: there is no corpus-side disposition that discards a selected item, so a failure can never become a silent downstream exclusion. A selected item that cannot be made searchable blocks the build instead of appearing here with a null documentVersionId.

allOf.description: A selected item is a document. The bijection is structural, not a downstream convention.
